title: சொந்த வீடு கட்டும் யோகம் (Own House Construction)
description: Moon (signifier of Cancer/4th house/womb/shelter) must be strong and free from malefic afflictions to build and own a house. Venus determines luxury and architectural grandeur.

title: செவ்வாய் 4-ம் பார்வை சொத்து சேர்க்கை (Mars 4th Aspect Real Estate)
description: Strong Mars casting its 4th aspect brings acquisition of landed properties, agricultural lands, plots, and real estate assets.

title: வீடு பழுது மற்றும் பிரச்சனைகள் (House Repairs / Disruptions)
description: Saturn and Ketu connecting with 4th house or 4th lord causes recurring damages, pipe leaks, cracks, and structural repairs in residences.
